soundness_flags.label: ass:polynomial-bandwidth
soundness_flags.one_line: The cited paper does not establish the displayed d=2 window 1/[2(s-2)]<a_h<1/10 as its standard undersmoothing condition; retag it novel and justify it from the nested remainder and pilot-error inequalities.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: honest_scope — inherited CiC identification
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Identification of the counterfactual map is assumed through the cyclically comonotone CiC model rather than contributed by this project.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: All inferential claims are conditional on the periodic-lift cyclically comonotone model and its map-identification conditions.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: honest_scope — continuous fixed-grid regime
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The result is limited to smooth positive torus densities, independent repeated cross-sections, fixed separated grids, and a fixed bandwidth regime.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The CLT, covariance estimator, and ellipses are claimed only in that continuous fixed-grid regime, not for raw count-valued Card--Krueger effects.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Source manuscript, bandwidth condition label assm:bandwidth_map_clt (lines 971–993) and Section 6 discussion of the d=2 uniform proposition (lines 2949–3074).
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: For its general d≥3 CLT the paper states n^{-1/(d+4)} << h_n << n^{-1/(d+2s)}, while its uniform d=2 proposition requires h_n >> n^{-1/6}; it also says the general variable-coefficient d=2 approximation error is leading order.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Retag ass:polynomial-bandwidth as novel and state the exact bias, stochastic-pilot, and quadratic-remainder inequalities whose simultaneous solution yields its exponent window; widen the window if those inequalities permit it.
Promote the nonseparable numerical kill test into a preregistered worked example with reported annular covariance increments and a generated-target remainder diagnostic.

For the local converse, specify the Green-aligned multiscale tangent family and its product-Hellinger calculation in the theorem’s construction notes, so the matched-rate route is auditable before proof development.
